name: ECG Lab deep audit PR3: PTB-XL+ morphology reference
cohortRole: Development reference, not a clinical holdout or diagnostic test
selection: Exclude any patient with an ECG in fold 9 or 10. Retain the smallest ECG ID per remaining patient. Rank patients by SHA256(seed:patient_id), take the first 512; take the first 64 for 12SL median beats. Never replace missing or difficult cases.
groupPolicy: Diagnostic superclass membership from SCP metadata with positive likelihood; groups overlap, are not angiographic adjudication, and are not used for selection.
featurePolicy: Use already harmonized columns in mV, ms, bpm or degrees; never reapply vendor conversion factors. Preserve signed S and T. Report missingness per feature and per group; do not impute.
medianPolicy: Read original WFDB16 bytes and explicit gain/baseline/unit. Cross-check with WFDB Python 4.3.1; only remove directory prefixes from header record/data names in a temporary copy, recording before/after hashes. No inferred gain or silent rescaling. Preserve absent or invalid windows with reasons.
windowPolicy: QRS/T windows are automatic 12SL fiducials in ms; baseline QRS onset-35 to -20 ms. A shared sample-metric extractor processes medians and generated signals but their window provenance differs. Results are descriptive, never paired clinical errors.
summaryPolicy: Linear quantiles type 7, sample SD, explicit denominators; axes use circular mean/resultant length, not linear means. R progression uses signed R,S only when all V1-V6 are available with R>=0 and S<=0; a zero/zero lead is undefined. No statistical quality threshold or generator tuning.
